2607.06447.title: Danus: Orchestrating Mathematical Reasoning Agents with Fact-Graph Memory
2607.06447.paper_summary: Recent LLM-based mathematical reasoning agents have begun to tackle research-level problems and, in several cases, have contributed to the resolution of open problems. However, scaling and orchestrating such agents effectively remains challenging, due to the difficulty of coordinating parallel proof search while keeping intermediate claims organized and reliable. In this paper, we propose Danus, an orchestration system for research-level mathematical reasoning centered on a shared fact graph as a global memory-management mechanism. Danus consists of a main agent that performs planning and coordination, multiple worker agents that carry out proof search in parallel, and a stateless verifier that checks proposed mathematical claims before they are admitted into the fact graph. Each verified fact is stored together with its proof and logical dependencies, allowing the system to build long arguments incrementally while keeping the shared proof state organized. The main agent periodically summarizes the evolving proof state, redirects workers across promising directions, and supports interaction with human mathematicians through progress reports. We evaluate Danus through six research-level case studies in algebraic geometry, singularity theory, and combinatorics, illustrating how the fact-graph memory mechanism enables Danus to construct long, detailed mathematical proofs. Our results suggest that fact-graph-based orchestration provides an effective route toward scaling mathematical reasoning agents for long-horizon research problems. Danus is open source at https://github.com/frenzymath/Danus.
2607.06447.paper_summary_zh: 最近基於LLM的數學推理代理已開始處理研究級問題，在幾個案例中，已對解決未解決的問題作出了貢獻。<lb/>然而，有效地擴展和協調這些代理仍然具有挑戰性，因為在保持中間聲明有序和可靠的同時協調平行證明搜索的難度很大。<lb/>在本文中，我們提出了Danus，一個以共享事實圖為中心的研究級數學推理協調系統，作為全球記憶管理機制。<lb/>Danus由一個主要代理組成，負責計劃和協調，數個工作代理平行進行證明搜索，以及一個無狀態的驗證器，在將提出的數學聲明納入事實圖之前檢查其正確性。<lb/>每個經過驗證的事實與其證明和邏輯依賴一起存儲，使系統能夠在保持共享證明狀態有序的同時，逐步構建長篇論證。<lb/>主要代理定期總結不斷演變的證明狀態，將工作人員引導到有前景的方向，並通過進度報告支持與人類數學家的互動。<lb/>我們通過六個在代數幾何、奇點理論和組合學的研究級案例研究來評估Danus，展示了事實圖記憶機制如何使Danus能夠構建長而詳細的數學證明。<lb/>我們的結果表明，基於事實圖的協調為擴展數學推理代理以解決長期研究問題提供了一條有效的途徑。<lb/>Danus的開源地址是 https://github.com/frenzymath/Danus。
